rows.en:
(Akimizu was saying, "I should get some exercise
once in a while..." so I invited her, but...)

\p-kun!
We're both on time today.

Yeah. When we're going all the way to the
artificial island, we need to plan ahead a bit.

Uh-huh!
I kept a close eye on the time today too.

You're really fired up.
Well, shall we go?

Wow~ The sea and the beach really are great!
I feel so free!

Yeah, I'm really glad there's a place
like this aboard the ship.
Um, well then, I'll go get changed...
Oh, okay. Then I'll go change too...

Akimizu's taking a while...
Does changing really take that long...?

\p-kun,
sorry to keep you waiting~...
Oh, Akimizu, you took a while.
(Whoa, th-this is...)

It's embarrassing,
so don't stare too much, okay?
(No, no, how do I put it...)
Ahh~ You've got a pervy look in your eyes~!
Wha-, no, I don't!
Kidding, kidding. Just a joke.
(Phew...)
rows.notes: x3, player; also nml_kln_017 after Klan leaves.

rows.en:
But in a swimsuit you can feel the breeze.
It really feels great~

Yeah, it's hard to believe
this is inside a ship.

Okay, time to get moving!
First up, that banana boat!
Ah, I'm coming too!

We sure played a lot~
I'm totally beat.

(...Akimizu's surprisingly athletic...
I'm pretty worn out...)

\p-kun,
thank you so much for today. It was fun.

No, I had fun too.
I'm glad we're friends, Akimizu.

Huh?!
..."Friends," huh...

Oh, um, it's nothing.
Shall we head home? It's getting late...
Yeah. I'll sleep well tonight~
(Seemed like Akimizu wanted to say something...)

(Yuu was saying, "I should get some exercise
once in a while..." so I invited her, but...)

\p-chan!
We're both on time today.

Yeah. When we're going all the way to the
artificial island, we need to plan ahead a bit.

You're really fired up.
Well, let's go.

Yeah, I'm really glad there's a place
like this aboard the ship.
Oh, wait, I'm coming too.

Yuu's taking a while...
And she told me to "go on ahead"...
Oh, Yuu, you took a while.
(Wow, Yuu really is something...)

Sorry I took so long...
My swimsuit was a little... No, never mind.
rows.notes: Akimizu, female scene; cut off as in the Japanese.

Y-you're not fooling anyone...
